Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a lesbian woman and a gay man were at the doctor's office because they weren't feeling well. For the lesbian woman, it was the fifth visit this year, but affording all the badly needed antiretroviral drugs is still out of reach. The gay man is almost never at the doctor's though, and just has a slight cough to get checked out. Who is sick because of AIDS?
A. The gay man
B. Not enough information
C. The lesbian woman
